**Best estimate:** **3,300,000 units** of HARBOE CSD sold in Danish retail in **2026-01**.

**Likely range:** **2,500,000–4,500,000 units**.

**Confidence:** **Low-to-moderate, ~40%**. The main uncertainty is that “units” depends on whether scanner data counts a 6-pack/18-pack as one unit or counts individual containers. I’m treating a unit as the **retail scanned consumer unit**.

**Reasoning:** I anchored the estimate on Danish off-trade soft-drink/carbonates volume: DTU, using Euromonitor data, reports 2025 Danish soft-drink sales of **966m liters**, with retail/off-trade representing **86%** of total soft drinks and **80%** for soda/carbonates specifically. ([food.dtu.dk](https://www.food.dtu.dk/-/media/institutter/foedevareinstituttet/publikationer/pub-2025/markeds-og-vareundersoegelse-af-energidrikke-i-danmark-final-report.pdf)) Harboe reported a **soft-drinks value share of 8.1%** over the 12 months to NielsenIQ MAT week 20 2025, and because Harboe is a low-price brand, I convert that to a higher volume share, roughly **11–14%**. ([financialreports.eu](https://financialreports.eu/filings/harboes-bryggeri/annual-report/2025/6461316/)) Harboe also reported broad 2025 distribution—“virtually all Danish retailers”—and 54% Danish consumer penetration for Harboe soft drinks, supporting a share above a niche-brand level. ([harboes.gcs-web.com](https://harboes.gcs-web.com/static-files/5b7da5bb-a45d-42fa-8a08-d0154dae2c44)) I estimate January at roughly **7–8%** of annual retail CSD volume, then divide Harboe’s estimated liters by an average scanned unit size of about **1.3–1.4 liters**, reflecting a mix of 33cl cans/multipacks, 50cl bottles, and large plastic bottles. ([lomax.dk](https://www.lomax.dk/foedevarer-og-koekken/drikkevarer/sodavand/harboe-cola-33-cl-60175910/?utm_source=openai))
